reason: The Archive item is a menu item in the Edit menu, which takes arrow keys, not Tab. On the live budget page Tab reaches the Edit button, Enter opens the menu with focus on its first item, ArrowDown moves to Archive, and Enter opens the Archive budget? dialog. The item is not in the sampled state's DOM once the dialog is open, so I tested from its parent state cards.budget-edit-menu.

Tab reaches the Edit control (a span with role button and tabindex 0), and Enter swaps the Where should we ship this card? step for Edit your personal mailing address inside the same modal. The sweep saw no new layer because the step changes in place. Focus then drops to body, a separate focus-management issue, not an inoperable trigger.

The sweep pressed Enter on the focusable Team Lunch table row (a tr), not on the button inside it. Tabbing on to the Assign budget to employees button and pressing Enter opens the Assign Team Lunch dialog and moves focus into it.

The sweep pressed Enter on the focusable Test Person table row (a tr, stop 51), which opens the budget page. Five stops later Tab reaches the Actions for Test Person button (aria-expanded false), and Enter opens its menu with focus on View details.

Tab reaches Next in the Assign Team Lunch modal and Enter moves the modal to its Set up budget cards step, so the button works from the keyboard. The step changes inside the same modal, so the sweep saw no new layer. Focus then drops to body, a separate focus-management issue.
